newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Foreign treasure-seekers search offshore Cambodia.
newsitem.headline: Foreign treasure-seekers search offshore Cambodia.

text.p: A French-Australian team of treasure hunters has begun searching for gold, porcelain and other riches in shipwrecks off the Cambodian coast, a newspaper reported on Friday.

The treasure hunters began to survey a reef about 70 km (45 miles) off the port of Sihanoukville on February 28, after winning a five-year concession to explore shipwrecks throughout the nation's waters, the Phnom Penh Post said.
Under the deal, any recovered objects of Khmer (Cambodian) origin would be turned over to the government .
Proceeds from the sale of recovered non-Khmer artifacts will be split with the foreign investors taking a 70 percent share and the government the remainder, the fortnightly newspaper said.
The Post said the explorers hoped to find Chinese porcelain and gold using state of the art scanners, sonars and metal detectors.
The search will initially focus on six wrecks, dating from the 15th to the late 19th centuries.
